pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: This is the Luminous Beasts Yeti, distinct from Skor. A hurt response can lead into a breathing action with a warning roar; move away from its front. Its melee actions also use delayed hits. Avoid reentering reach immediately after the first wind-up; wait for the motion to finish.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Yeti Trophy, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Next step
pages.text: This victory belongs to the branch for: Maledictus. The other victories in that branch are also required. Sibling prerequisite encounters can be completed in any order.
